Package com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation

Class KfeColdWalletObservationService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.wallet.adapters.in.observation.KfeColdWalletObservationService
@Service @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.cold-observation.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class KfeColdWalletObservationService extends Object
Indexes on-chain activity for KfeWalletKind.WATCH_ONLY wallets into transactions_master so history/confirmations appear without a full chain indexer.

Inbound observations come from UTXO scans (listunspent + scantxoutset). Outbound cold spends are primarily recorded at PSBT broadcast; this service refreshes their confirmations and keeps observed_sats aligned via KfeOnchainBalanceSyncService.

    • observeWallet

      public void observeWallet(UUID walletId)
      Observes one cold wallet. Chain probes run outside a DB transaction; ledger/history writes use a short TransactionTemplate afterwards.

      Holding a TX across scantxoutset/listunspent exhausted Hikari and (when nested under broadcast+audit) held GLOBAL_AUDIT_APPENDER for minutes. Serialized per wallet against concurrent schedule/ZMQ observes.

    • ingestZmqRawTx

      public void ingestZmqRawTx(KfeBitcoinZmqTxMatcher.ParsedRawTx parsed, Set<UUID> walletIds)
      Instant path: materialize cold inbound/outbound from a ZMQ rawtx payload at 0 confirmations (mempool) without scantxoutset. Full observeWallet(java.util.UUID) still runs afterwards for balance accuracy and confirmation refresh.
